stem: Two postharvest containers were moved and one identity label is unreadable. What is the strongest Technician II action?
choices: Guess identity from appearance and continue processing
Stop downstream combination or release, preserve the containers, and reconstruct identity from genealogy and movement records under procedure
Relabel both containers with the same lot number
Discard the movement records and start a new record
rationale: Identity uncertainty is a traceability and QA problem. Product should not be combined or released until identity is defensibly reconstructed by authorized records and procedure.
